title: Update buttons for adding Connections, Variables and Pools
body: The UI pattern introduced in #60555 is clean and well-structured 🙌 Following that direction, this PR updates the action buttons on the Variables and Pools pages to use icon-only buttons with tooltips. This aligns them with the existing pattern used on the Connections page (`AddConnectionButton`) and improves visual consistency across the Admin section.
